intro.label: Pocket
intro.body: Kick on every quarter and 8th hats from the top. Bass is silent for two bars, then enters with halves.

intro.label: Figure
intro.body: Halves, not the verse 8ths that come later. Root on 1 sits under the downbeat kick. Up to the fifth on 3 sits under the beat-3 kick.

intro.label: Harmony
intro.body: The intro never leaves C. Bass states the root and the fifth only, in half notes, after the kit has already set the floor.

intro.label: Missable
intro.body: The entrance is two halves. Playing the verse's root-fifth 8ths on bar 3 rushes a moment that is supposed to be long.

v1.label: Pocket
v1.body: Kick remains four-on-the-floor and snare is on 2 and 4. Bass leaves the halves behind for quarters plus 8ths, root then fifth.

v1.label: Figure
v1.body: Order is root, root, fifth. Root on 1 is a quarter with the downbeat. Root on 2 meets the next kick. The fifth on the and of 2 falls in the gap.

v1.label: Harmony
v1.body: Harmony walks C, G, Am, then F, each chord lasting two bars. Bass roots every change instead of pedaling C.

v1.label: Missable
v1.body: Each chord owns two bars. Changing bass root after one bar anticipates G, Am, or F before the harmony does.

verse.label: Pocket
verse.body: Four-on-the-floor and snare on 2 and 4 return. Unlike verse 1, beat 3 splits into 8ths and the second one is a chord tone.

insight.title: Verse grid plus a chord tone on 3

verse.label: Figure
verse.body: Opening matches verse 1; the added chord tone is not in these three attacks. Root on 1, root on 2, then the fifth on the and of 2.

verse.label: Harmony
verse.body: Harmony repeats the verse order, two bars apiece, from C through F. New inside the bar: a chord tone on the and of 3, E when the chord is C.

verse.label: Missable
verse.body: The and of 3 is a chord tone (E on the C bars), one 8th. Running a longer lick there overplays a single added note.

insight.title: Don't turn beat 3 into a fill

pre.label: Pocket
pre.body: The floor stays four kicks a bar. Bass stops vamping and plays a quarter-note arpeggio, one chord tone per beat.

pre.label: Figure
pre.body: Quarters climb the Dm triad, and the floor has a kick on every beat so each tone lands in one. Root on 1, then the minor third on 2, then the fifth on 3.

pre.label: Harmony
pre.body: Two bars of Dm, then two of G7. The G7 bar's last quarter is F, the seventh, which the Dm arpeggio did not have.

pre.label: Missable
pre.body: Beat 2 is the minor third, F, a full quarter. The verse's root-then-fifth 8ths skip that Dm arpeggio.

ch1.label: Pocket
ch1.body: Still four-on-the-floor. Bass adds an octave on the last 16th of beat 1, then the fifth on 2, and the chord lasts only one bar.

insight.title: One bar per chord, plus an octave pop

ch1.label: Figure
ch1.body: The hook's 16th pop is the new event. Root on 1, octave on the a of 1, then down to the fifth on 2. Kicks catch the root and the fifth. The pop is between them.

ch1.label: Harmony
ch1.body: Harmony flips every bar: C then G then Am then F, and that loop runs twice. The verse had given each of those chords two bars.

ch1.label: Missable
ch1.body: Beat 4 is the fifth, but the and of 4 steps outside the chord (F# when the bar is C). Holding G there misses the hook's exit.

insight.title: Don't stay on the fifth at the end of the bar

chorus.label: Pocket
chorus.body: The octave pop and one-bar changes return, but the last four bars stop changing and sit on C. The kit never syncopates with that pop.

insight.title: Chorus hook, then a C pedal

chorus.label: Figure
chorus.body: Exit uses the hook, then the harmony parks. Root on 1, the octave on the a of 1 pops once more, and fifth on 2 answers underneath the following kick.

chorus.label: Harmony
chorus.body: The one-bar chord changes return, and unlike the first chorus the phrase stops by holding C instead of repeating the loop.

chorus.label: Missable
chorus.body: After the loop, the harmony parks on C. Another G or F in those bars invents a change the outro does not make.

insight.title: Don't keep changing chords in the last four bars

v2.label: Pocket
v2.body: Four-on-the-floor and snare on 2 and 4 return. Unlike verse 1, beat 3 splits into 8ths and the second one is a chord tone.

insight.title: Verse grid plus a chord tone on 3

v2.label: Figure
v2.body: Opening matches verse 1; the added chord tone is not in these three attacks. Root on 1, root on 2, then the fifth on the and of 2.

v2.label: Harmony
v2.body: Harmony repeats the verse order, two bars apiece, from C through F. New inside the bar: a chord tone on the and of 3, E when the chord is C.

v2.label: Missable
v2.body: The and of 3 is a chord tone (E on the C bars), one 8th. Running a longer lick there overplays a single added note.

insight.title: Don't turn beat 3 into a fill

br.label: Pocket
br.body: The kick grid does not change. Bass slows to a dotted quarter, a short fifth, then a half-note octave, and leaves the 16ths alone.

insight.title: Half-note roots, fifth on the and of 2

br.label: Figure
br.body: Slow, and wide, next to the chorus hook. Root on 1 is long. The fifth on the and of 2 is the short note. Octave on 3 is a half note under the beat-3 kick.

br.label: Harmony
br.body: Harmony leaves the chorus loop. It opens on Am, passes F and C, and cadences on G7, two bars each.

br.label: Missable
br.body: The chorus 16th pop on the a of 1 is absent. The octave arrives on 3, as a half note, so an early pop belongs only to the chorus.

insight.title: Don't import the chorus octave pop
